42:3.text: Thus has He revealed to you,
, and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

42:4.text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

42:5.text: The heavens almost break from above them,
with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

42:6.text: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is
, are not over them a manager.

42:7.text: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities
and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

42:8.text: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them
one religion, but He admits whom He wills
into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.

42:9.text: besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

42:10.text: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is
, "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."
